title: Billing Reconciliation Drift After Provider Migration
gradingCriteria: Identifies that Adyen refunds reuse the capture provider_reference/pspReference, so idempotency_key missing event_type or eventId can skip legitimate refunds.
Explains why missing refunds make internal net revenue higher than provider exports.
Identifies ledger_day timezone mismatch: internal local merchant day is compared to provider UTC settlement date, causing concentration around 23:00-01:00 UTC.
Proposes a durable idempotency key that includes provider plus provider event identity, or provider_reference + event_type + eventId where appropriate, without breaking Stripe historical behavior.
Backfill plan separates raw event replay from ledger writes, is scoped to Adyen EUR refunds after migration, and verifies against provider exports before posting.
Adds monitoring by provider/event_type/UTC settlement date and duplicate-skip counts.
